fields.name: Session
fields.evidence: Windows creator bg3.exe+0x201CB90 (AllocRaw 0x28) writes the null handle, then its entity parameter. macOS SubsystemHelper::InitializeLocalSessionComponents creates it on the session entity together with CameraComponent, CommandQueueComponent and StateMachineComponent. Live: the session character handle.

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.evidence: Windows creator writes a 16-bit 0. macOS InitializeLocalSessionComponents copies a 16-bit value of its arguments here; GetDataForLocalPlayers / TryGetLocalPlayerData (macOS) select sessions by it. Local player ids are 16-bit in the game (ui::Widget::GetPlayerId returns short). Live 1 (= ecl::character::AssignedComponent of the same character).

fields.name: _Pad1A
fields.evidence: not written by the creator (live 0xFFFF / 0xFFFFFFFF garbage)

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: Windows creator writes DAT_146174970 (the null EntityHandle; live 0xffc0000000000000). The macOS creator stores an exported Unassigned constant there instead (8 bytes), so the type is not settled.

summary: Local state of a character-creation session (read with CameraComponent by the editor subsystems). situation 'respec' (Osi.StartRespec on the host, then the character editor's commands, level SYS_CC_I); born together with the other ecl::character_creation components of this batch.
open_questions: Members between +0xC and +0x1A: the Windows creator stores 8 bytes at +0xC, 4 at +0x14 and 2 at +0x18, the macOS one 8 at +0xC and 8 at +0x12 - the split is not settled and no Windows reader was found.
Type of +0x20 (null EntityHandle on Windows, an Unassigned constant on macOS).
second_pass: Named +0 (session entity) and +8 (16-bit local player id) from the Windows creator bg3.exe+0x201CB90 plus macOS InitializeLocalSessionComponents; the middle members and +0x20 remain open because no Windows reader was found.
